ground_truth.context: Table 1 ("Automating Air Quality Monitoring System and PM₁₀ Concentrations"), Panel A, column (1).  Non-parametric local linear regression discontinuity estimate of the jump in reported daily PM₁₀ concentrations at the date a city's air quality monitoring was automated; the running variable is days from the automation date, with separate slopes before and after.  Triangle kernel, bandwidth chosen by the Calonico, Cattaneo and Titiunik (2014) optimal bandwidth method.  No fixed effects or covariates.  Sample: all monitoring stations in the Wave 1 and Wave 2 cities with pollution data before and after automation, station-day observations 2011-2016.  Standard errors clustered at the city level.

cell.label: claude-code
deviations_manifest: rdrobust run with masspoints='off' (the R default 'adjust' gives bandwidths 179/494 days; 'off' reproduces the paper's 109/263-day bandwidths, consistent with the pre-2020 Stata rdrobust). Reported RD coefficient is the conventional local-linear estimate.

'Deadline' stations defined by automation date (exactly 2013-01-01 or 2014-01-01) regardless of listed wave: this gives the 242 treated / 123 control stations in the Table 1 notes (24 of the 242 are in cities coded wave 2). Panel A col 5 uses the same definition (73 cities, not the 84 quoted in the text; N within bandwidth 86,042 matches the table).

Matched event-study sample (Panel B cols 3 and 5): each 2013-01-01 station paired with its haversine-nearest 2014-01-01 station, with replacement, and the control station's data duplicated per match. This gives 231,990 obs rather than the paper's 186,499; none of the alternative definitions tried in exploratory attempts 5-6 (Euclidean or swapped coordinates, unique pairs, city-level matching, reverse matching) hit 186,499, so the literal description was kept. Station FE use the original station id.
Residualization for cols 3-5 uses residuals from the full-sample regression (station FE + month-of-year FE + four weather controls), then subsets. Singletons dropped as reghdfe would (19 in AOD).

Search RD: daily Baidu indices averaged to city-month; city weather = mean over the city's stations; months from automation = calendar-month difference to the city's modal station automation date (14 cities have several station dates).
cell.notes: Data: pollution + weather station-day merged (1,049,325 obs with PM10 and all weather, matching the paper). Panel A RDs reproduce the paper's coefficients, SEs, bandwidths and N within bandwidth to rounding (34.72, 34.89, 27.55, 64.65, 57.14; AOD -0.0049 with N=5,851, h=7). Panel B cols 1-2 (deadline sample, Jan 2012-Dec 2013, treated x event-bin dummies with Nov-Dec 2012 as reference, station FE + month or year-month FE + weather, city-clustered) reproduce 60.31 and 31.44 and N=176,426 exactly. The matched columns are off (51.8 vs 66.5; log 0.18 vs 0.24) because the matched sample could not be reconstructed (231,990 vs 186,499 obs). Search RDs: 10.00 (mask) and 8.21 (filter), observation counts 8,661/8,590 match the paper. One claim comparison was made (attempt-4); after exploratory checks of matching definitions failed to find the paper's sample, the final run is a copy of attempt-4. No run hung. Read README.pdf in the mount (documentation, not a script).
